desc_ko: Direct Drive Tech Limited is a China-based company primarily engage in the sales of robotic actuator modules, and to a lesser extent, robots. The Company's product portfolio includes robotic actuator modules and robots. The robotic actuator modules comprise robotic direct drive actuator modules and embodied joint modules. The robot offerings include the Diablo robot, TITA and TITATIT robots and D1 robot. The Company's products are utilized in both consumer, industrial and commercial application scenarios. The Company conducts its businesses in the domestic market.
